newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina shuts 137 shops briefly for tax evasion.
newsitem.headline: Argentina shuts 137 shops briefly for tax evasion.

text.p: Argentina's National Tax Service (DGI) closed 137 shops for a minimum of three days and fined 2,000 more that were not paying taxes, DGI chief Carlos Silvani said.
He told reporters Tuesday night that in the 30 days since new legislation on tax-related closures went into effect, the DGI had inspected 10,000 shops.
A total of 137 outlets were shut down for a minimum of three days, including stores selling clothes and miscellaneous goods as well as coffee shops and restaurants.
The DGI also filed charges against 40 companies for tax evasion which could result in prison terms, Silvani said.
"We're very proud of the results of the law on closures," Silvani said.
